source.title: UGC Minimum Z scores for selection to various Courses of Study in respect of each district

nqcDefinition: NQC - No Qualified Candidates. This may be due to the following reasons. 1. District quota for a given course of study in a given district has already been filled by the students of that district. 2. Number of places in a given course of study in a given university has already been filled by the students with higher Z-scores from other districts.
